planted.description: LCL_ALV->GET_FIELDCAT (in ZSC4SAP_GS01C) builds LVC_T_FCAT by hand with nine repeated APPEND VALUE #( fieldname = ... ) TO rt_fcat statements instead of the SALV factory + cl_salv_controller_metadata=>get_lvc_fieldcatalog standard. Contradicts spec.md §5.
planted.detection_hint: Grep the C include for "APPEND" ... "TO rt_fcat" repeated per column; absence of get_lvc_fieldcatalog.
planted.fix: Replace GET_FIELDCAT body with cl_salv_table=>factory on an empty ty_t_flight + get_lvc_fieldcatalog; keep per-column changes in REFINE_FCAT.
planted.line_basis: statement end line (period) of each APPEND

unavoidable_secondary_findings: OCCUPANCY column typed by hand (datatype DEC, intlen 5, decimals 2) inside the same manual build — same root cause, count as GS01-P1, not a separate finding.

must_not_flag.construct: Program / include / FG / FM names ZSC4SAP_GS* do not follow Z{MODULE}{TYPE}{NN}, Z{MODULE}FG_, Z{MODULE}FM_
must_not_flag.reason: common/naming-conventions.md § Exceptions: ZSC4SAP_* harness objects in $TMP → §7 N/A (also listed in spec.md § Naming).

must_not_flag.construct: Objects are in $TMP without a transport request
must_not_flag.reason: Local golden-set objects; interview.md dim 6.

must_not_flag.construct: No verify-phase4.md for the screen / GUI status
must_not_flag.reason: Golden-set run feeds Phase 6 only; reviewers verify screens / statuses directly (run-plan.md).

must_not_flag.construct: Classic Open SQL without @ host-variable escaping / comma field lists
must_not_flag.reason: common/abap-release-reference.md § 1a: abapRelease 740 with abapSp unset → classic Open SQL, recorded in spec.md ("SP unknown — classic SQL").

must_not_flag.construct: Main program header block above REPORT (Module / Program ID / Tcode / Old Program ID / Title / Description + Change History)
must_not_flag.reason: common/clean-code-procedural.md § Mandatory Main Program Header (both paradigms); common/clean-code.md § Comments names it as the one allowed banner.

must_not_flag.construct: DATA / FIELD-SYMBOLS declared inside a FORM, METHOD or MODULE
must_not_flag.reason: common/clean-code-procedural.md § Global vs Local: "DATA inside a FORM, METHOD or MODULE body is local and allowed"; phase6-review.md §6.

must_not_flag.construct: No SELECT COUNT(*) pre-check / no secondary key on the result table
must_not_flag.reason: SFLIGHT / SCARR are small demo tables, not the transactional tables the clean-code.md secondary-key / COUNT rule names.

must_not_flag.construct: MESSAGE ... TYPE gc_msgty_* / DISPLAY LIKE gc_msgty_*
must_not_flag.reason: Message types come from constants — compliant with common/constant-rule.md.

must_not_flag.construct: Field-name literals in CASE <fcat>-fieldname ('SEATSMAX', 'OCCUPANCY')
must_not_flag.reason: common/constant-rule.md § Exceptions: field catalog modification.

must_not_flag.construct: IF sy-subrc <> 0. CLEAR … / RETURN. after a SELECT ... INTO TABLE
must_not_flag.reason: Explicit handling of the empty result; not an empty branch.

must_not_flag.construct: No AUTHORITY-CHECK before the SFLIGHT / SCARR reads
must_not_flag.reason: SAP demo data, not restricted business data (common/clean-code.md § Security and Data Handling targets restricted data); harness exemption recorded in spec.md §8.

must_not_flag.construct: A shared, non-executed syntax-guide include pulled in by INCLUDE (house practice)
must_not_flag.reason: common/naming-conventions.md § Exceptions: never generated, never flagged. Not applicable here — no such include exists in this case; a finding about it is a false positive.

must_not_flag.construct: Flow logic lines are "MODULE status_0100." without an OUTPUT / INPUT keyword
must_not_flag.reason: Dynpro flow-logic syntax never carries OUTPUT/INPUT (phase6-review.md §1, phase4-verify.md a1/a2); the lines are uncommented. Regression guard.

must_not_flag.construct: LEAVE TO SCREEN 0
must_not_flag.reason: Standard return from a called screen; not a magic screen number, not LEAVE PROGRAM error handling.

must_not_flag.construct: NEW cl_gui_docking_container( ) / NEW cl_gui_custom_container( ) / NEW cl_gui_alv_grid( ) without EXCEPTIONS
must_not_flag.reason: common/clean-code.md § Expressions and Constructors: prefer NEW over CREATE OBJECT.

must_not_flag.construct: WHEN OTHERS branch holding only a comment in the user-command CASE / fieldcat CASE
must_not_flag.reason: common/ok-code-pattern.md Step 3 template ends with an empty WHEN OTHERS.

must_not_flag.construct: OK_CODE variable named ok_code (no g prefix), screen OKCODE NAME = OK_CODE
must_not_flag.reason: common/ok-code-pattern.md Step 1: any one name declared in TOP; common/clean-code-procedural.md g-prefix rule exempts ok_code.

must_not_flag.construct: READ TABLE mt_outtab INDEX iv_row INTO DATA(ls_flight) instead of VALUE #( itab[ … ] OPTIONAL )
must_not_flag.reason: Table expressions with OPTIONAL need 740 SP08; abapSp is unset (common/abap-release-reference.md § 1a).

must_not_flag.construct: One-line *& Include {NAME} banner at the top of each include
must_not_flag.reason: common/clean-code-procedural.md § Mandatory Main Program Header: includes get only this one-line banner.

must_not_flag.construct: Local classes without FINAL
must_not_flag.reason: common/clean-code-oop.md: "FINAL is allowed, not required"; phase6-review.md §8 ("FINAL optional").

must_not_flag.construct: No {PROG}f and no {PROG}a include
must_not_flag.reason: common/include-structure.md: OOP uses f only when FORMs exist and never a (LCL_ALV lives in c).

must_not_flag.construct: Plain CL_GUI_ALV_GRID in a docking container instead of ZCL_S4SAP_CM_ALV; text symbols instead of S_UNIFIED_CON; no MESSAGE-ID
must_not_flag.reason: Profile alvFramework = none (recipe.json alv_framework, spec.md §2): common/oop-pattern.md § ALV Framework; phase6-review.md §5 "with none … PASS".

must_not_flag.reason: common/ok-code-pattern.md Step 3: OOP may dispatch in an LCL_ALV method; copy + CLEAR is done.

must_not_flag.construct: GO_DATA / GO_ALV declared in {PROG}C after CLASS … DEFINITION DEFERRED, not in TOP
must_not_flag.reason: common/oop-pattern.md § Two-Class Split; common/naming-conventions.md § Global References.

must_not_flag.construct: CALCULATE_OCCUPANCY / CALCULATE_FREE_SEATS is PUBLIC
must_not_flag.reason: Called from LCL_TEST — common/clean-code-oop.md: a test caller is a demonstrated need; phase6-review.md §5.

must_not_flag.reason: Called from PBO / PAI modules and the event handler — callers outside the class (phase6-review.md §5).

must_not_flag.reason: common/oop-pattern.md § Event Wiring (E follows C) and the CREATE OBJECT exception in common/clean-code-oop.md § Constructors.

must_not_flag.reason: Bootstrap method of common/oop-pattern.md § Main Program Orchestration; behaviour documented in spec.md §3.

must_not_flag.construct: Local classes without interfaces / own exception class
must_not_flag.reason: Report-local LCL_DATA / LCL_ALV as in the canonical common/oop-sample/ (no interfaces, no own exception class); no exception is raised by the program.

must_not_flag.construct: Numeric literals (seat counts, expected results) in test methods
must_not_flag.reason: Test data, not business logic.
